note: directions only, hashed before the main test. Amplitudes are solved at run time to realise each registered Mahalanobis separation, which is a property of the operator and not a choice

payload.construction: pairs constructed weak under DIRECT_PHYSICAL and stronger under RESOLVED_PHYSICAL, to test whether higher orders create usable discriminability
payload.defect_rule: a method exceeding the equal-prior data-only Bayes bound by more than Monte Carlo tolerance is an instrumentation or leakage defect, not a success
